scope: Classic CANopen CiA 301 / examples; source anchors and assumptions

claims.claim: NMT has Initialization, Pre-operational, Operational and Stopped states; PDO is disabled in Pre-operational.
claims.notes: CiA description of classic CANopen communication permissions

claims.claim: Boot-up reports transition from initialization to Pre-operational; normal state codes are 7F, 05, 04.
claims.locator: NMT/Heartbeat, NMT internal state enumeration and first heartbeat
claims.notes: 00 is the Boot-up payload, not generic periodic initialization state

claims.claim: NMT frame uses CAN-ID 0 with two data bytes command and node ID, zero broadcasts.
Producer heartbeat interval is OD 1017 and consumer supervision is OD 1016.

claims.locator: OD heartbeat settings; calculation in reference/canopen_ch19_21.py

claims.claim: Legacy node guarding replies carry toggle bit and NMT state; heartbeat does not.
claims.notes: Do not parse guarding alternation as heartbeat

claims.claim: A 200-ms heartbeat and 600-ms consumer timeout demonstrate an engineering margin, not a mandated ratio.
claims.notes: Actual timeout depends on load, jitter and safety analysis
